In Bangladesh public procurement, tenders are run as **NCT** (National Competitive Tendering) or **ICT** (International Competitive Tendering). Both are published and managed on the e-GP portal under the Public Procurement Act 2006 and the Public Procurement Rules (PPR) 2025, administered by BPPA.

::: {.callout-warning}
Here **ICT** means *International* Competitive Tendering. It is unrelated to the ICT Division (Information and Communication Technology), which is mentioned below only as a place that posts tech tenders.
:::

### Key Differences

| Feature | NCT (National) | ICT (International) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Aimed at** | The domestic market | Foreign as well as domestic suppliers and contractors |
| **Tender document fee** | Paid in BDT | Tk 12,000 per tender (e-GP release, August 2025); an earlier release required USD |
| **Tender security** | In BDT | In USD (July 2024 e-GP release) |
| **e-GP registration** | Local tenderer registration | A separate international tenderer registration; fees listed as Tk 12,000 (registration) and Tk 5,000 (renewal) |
| **Foreign bank details** | Not needed | SWIFT code or routing number can be entered |
| **SLT price screening** | Applies | Does not apply (e-GP states SLT is for national tenders only) |
| **Typical use** | Routine goods, small-to-medium works, local services | Specialised goods, high-value or technology-intensive contracts |

The "typical use" row is a rule of thumb. The choice for a given package follows the PPR and the procuring entity's market assessment, not a fixed list.

### Which Document Fits

BPPA publishes separate standard tender documents for national procurement (for example e-PW3 for works and e-PPS3 for physical services, both labelled "National") and for international procurement. Pick the one that matches the package category and method.

### Where to Find Tenders

- **e-GP portal:** the official platform where both NCT and ICT packages are published.
- **Ministries and departments:** the [ICT Division](https://ictd.gov.bd/pages/tenders) and the [Department of ICT](https://doict.gov.bd/pages/tenders) post tenders for technology tools, networks and consultancy.
- **Aggregators:** [BDTender](https://bdtender.com/dept/Org-673/ministry-information-communication-technology/ict-division-tender-notice) collects notices from the ICT ministry. It is a private site, so confirm every notice on e-GP.
